# Stand Firm in the Gap
## Scripture
"Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Brother, the enemy doesn't attack the lukewarm. He attacks the man who is a threat to his kingdom. When you decide to lead your home, pray boldly, and walk in integrity, you put a target on your back. But notice the order in Paul's command: watch, stand fast, be brave, be strong. It's a progression. You can't be strong if you haven't first learned to watch—to be alert to the temptations, distractions, and subtle compromises creeping into your day. And you can't stand fast if you haven't decided where you'll plant your feet before the battle starts.

Your strength isn't manufactured in the moment of crisis; it's built in the quiet mornings of obedience. When you anchor yourself in Scripture and prayer, you're not just reading words—you're reinforcing the foundation of your soul. The battle belongs to the Lord, but He calls you to hold the line. Today, be a man who watches over his heart, his family, and his calling. Don't just react to the chaos—stand firm in the gap, and let your courage be a wall for those behind you.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and for each one, say aloud one area of your life where you will stand firm today.
